critical_code_review_comments: Home landscape math is clean: grid `flex:1, gap: SP.sm`, gridRow `flex:1 flexDirection:row`, gridItem `flex:1`. With SP.sm=8 the 2x2 grid fills content area exactly. Observed cards bottom at y=305 with resume banner visible (which pushes grid down ~40px) — even in the worst case the grid finishes ~20px above the AD banner + tab bar composite region, so no clipping.

Turn pill in game/[id].tsx is vertical column bottom-right — verified live: pill height 42, inner text 16px, single line, no wrap. Position x=682 y=340 (in 844x390 viewport) gives ~10px margin from viewport edges. ✅

HandFan max card bottom=388 within 390 viewport — 2px margin, tight but working. If a device reports 1px more chrome this could clip; consider explicit bottom padding of 4-6px in HandFan container for safety, but not required.
Profile headerCard is a proper flex row (flexDirection:'row', gap: SP.lg). eloRow has flex:1 with 3 eloBadge flex:1 — verified renders as 3 equal badges to the right of the info block.
Matchmaking at 780x360 (tightest supported viewport) still fits with 12px margin at the bottom for cancel-search-button. Same margin as at 844x390 — layout scales correctly.
Tutorial lesson-ok-button width: 560px cap is applied via maxWidth in styles (verified live). Button is centered with equal horizontal margins.

Console 'shadow*' style deprecation warnings appear multiple times (React Native web complaining about StyleSheet 'shadowColor', 'shadowOffset', 'shadowRadius' being deprecated in favor of 'boxShadow'). Non-blocking, purely a warning, comes from `shadow` in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Consider migrating to `boxShadow` in a future pass but not urgent.
